comment: Legallas's process maps for Git Crafter actions/pages (format: Git Crafter pages/maps/README.md). Each step names one metric, legallas.<page>.<id>, from quality-speed/pages/<page>/manifest.json, rated by that manifest's goal through adapt.ts. Library maps keep their step ids and rules; only metrics change.

load.rule: The README costs an agent 1,000 tokens or fewer to load.

score.rule: The settings drill catches every planted drift on every run.

maps.name: The room
maps.why: A member's question, from search to a cited record they may see, with nothing leaking and nothing missing
maps.ideal: A member finds any record they may see in seconds, trusts every cite, sees nothing they should not, and it costs an AI little.

steps.name: Search
steps.rule: A search answers within 1 second at the 95th percentile.

steps.name: Open
steps.rule: The right document opens within 2.5 seconds.

steps.name: Cite
steps.rule: 98 of 100 quotes match the source word for word.

steps.name: Gate
steps.rule: A stranger is refused before any record is read.

steps.name: Complete
steps.rule: A founder walks the whole journey on the sample room with no dead end.

steps.name: Cost
steps.rule: A search result costs an AI 10,000 tokens at most.

maps.name: Law library
maps.why: A rule, form or deadline, from its official source to a dated answer an AI can look up cheaply
maps.ideal: Every rule a founder or investor relies on is in the pack, verified at its official source, current, and cheap to look up.

steps.name: Cover
steps.rule: Every rule a founder or investor needs is in the pack.

steps.name: Verify
steps.rule: Every entry is marked verified against its official source.

steps.name: Rights
steps.rule: Every entry may be fetched or linked by an install.

steps.name: Refresh
steps.rule: Every entry was checked against its source within 365 days.

steps.name: Lag
steps.rule: No amendment to a relied-on rule waits unreflected.

steps.name: Look up
steps.rule: A lookup costs an AI 2,250 tokens at most.

maps.name: Set up
maps.why: A company's folder and its own AI, from first sync to answering from the room, with nothing else let in
maps.ideal: Every company file is searchable within ten seconds, the customer's own AI connects in a few steps, and no other AI gets in.

steps.name: Read
steps.rule: Every file's words reach the index, or the file is named.

steps.name: Index
steps.rule: A change is searchable text within 10 seconds.

steps.name: Untouched
steps.rule: Sync reads a clone, so the folder's own files never change.

steps.name: Guide
steps.rule: The longest setup is 7 steps or fewer.

steps.name: Refuse
steps.rule: All 9 probes from an unlisted AI are refused.

steps.name: Tool list
steps.rule: The tool list costs an AI 10,000 tokens at most.

maps.name: Templates
maps.why: A template, from needed to filled, that may ship and never claims a lawyer reviewed it
maps.ideal: Every template a founder or investor needs exists, may ship, fills cleanly, and never claims a lawyer reviewed it.

sources.title: Claude Code docs: MCP output limits and warnings

steps.name: Need
steps.rule: Every template a founder or investor needs exists.

steps.name: Rights
steps.rule: Every template carries a licence that lets it ship.

steps.name: Fields
steps.rule: Every field fills, and none is left as a placeholder.

steps.name: Wording
steps.rule: Every template says no lawyer has reviewed it, and makes no banned claim.

steps.name: Fill
steps.rule: A template fills within 100 ms.

steps.name: Size
steps.rule: One template part costs an AI 10,000 tokens at most.

maps.name: Testing
maps.why: A real risk, from named to proven by a test that fails when it breaks, fast and never flaky
maps.ideal: Every real risk has a test that fails when it breaks, nothing is flaky, and the suite runs in about a minute.

steps.name: Risk
steps.rule: Every named risk has a test that fails when the risk is planted.

steps.name: Mutate
steps.rule: 8 of 10 planted breaks in risky code fail a test.

steps.name: Flaky
steps.rule: 3 full suite runs on one commit agree.

steps.name: Fast
steps.rule: The web test step runs in 60 seconds or less.

steps.name: CPU
steps.rule: The suite uses 2 CPU minutes or less.

maps.name: Mac app and launch
maps.why: A Mac app change, from building on main to a verified bundle, and the conditions to sell closing
maps.ideal: Every Mac app change on main builds, tests and verifies within ten minutes, the same bytes each time, with every condition to sell met.

steps.name: Build
steps.rule: Every Swift job on main's code passes.

steps.name: Time
steps.rule: A Swift job runs in 10 minutes or less.

steps.name: Bundle
steps.rule: The app has the right identity, entitlements and sandbox.

steps.name: Repeat
steps.rule: Two builds of one commit give identical bytes.

steps.name: Conditions
steps.rule: Every condition to sell is met by a merged change.

steps.name: Minutes
steps.rule: The launch lane runs in 5 minutes or less.

maps.name: Assurance
maps.why: A firm's security questions, from a covered policy to live evidence, with the automation holding only what it uses
maps.ideal: A firm's security team gets every document it asks for, current and true to the code, and the automation holds only what it uses.

sources.title: NIST CSWP 29: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0

steps.name: Cover
steps.rule: Every policy area a security team asks about has a document.

steps.name: Evidence
steps.rule: Every citation in the 7 policies resolves at HEAD.

steps.name: Review
steps.rule: Every policy was reviewed within a year.

steps.name: Restore
steps.rule: A restore drill passed in the sample room within 90 days.

steps.name: Least access
steps.rule: The App holds exactly the permissions its workflows use.

steps.name: Minutes
steps.rule: The compliance lane runs in 5 minutes or less.

maps.name: Secure
maps.why: A repo's security, from keys no session reads to dependencies and alerts closed within a week
maps.ideal: No session reads a key, scans and dependency review run on every change, AI audits find nothing open, and alerts close within a week.

steps.name: Keys
steps.rule: No key or secret is ever committed: the history scan finds none.

steps.name: Scan
steps.rule: A scan runs on every push and finishes in minutes.

steps.name: Dependency review
steps.rule: A pull request that adds a high-severity vulnerable dependency fails CI.

steps.name: AI security audits
steps.rule: Every audit and static analysis finding is fixed, so none stays open.

steps.name: Model
steps.rule: The threat model is reviewed whenever the attack surface changes.

steps.name: Alerts
steps.rule: An open alert closes within a week.

maps.name: Edge
maps.why: A room's Workers on Cloudflare, from the Workers guide to a current runtime, deployed only from reviewed code
maps.ideal: Every Workers item in Cloudflare's guide is met or recorded with a reason, on a current compatibility date, deployed only from reviewed code.

steps.name: Workers guide
steps.rule: Every guide item is met in the example configs and code, or accepted with a reason.

steps.name: Compatibility date
steps.rule: The three example configs' compatibility date is under 60 days old.

steps.name: Reviewed deploys
steps.rule: Only a reviewed commit whose CI passed reaches a Worker: rulesets and required checks stay on.
